en: A black and white image showing a historical European town. The foreground features a small stream, fences, and trees lining a quiet road. Surrounding the road are residential houses with traditional gabled roofs, some with visible timber framing. Dominating the left background is a large church with a prominent Baroque-style onion dome. In the distant background, numerous tall factory chimneys suggest industrial activity. The overall appearance is serene with a mix of historic and industrial architecture, typical of Central European towns.
